```{r}
library(quantmod)
library(tidyverse)
library(tsibble)
library(fpp3)
library(seasonal)
```

```{r}
get_df <- function(symbol, source = "yahoo", silent = TRUE){
  result <- tryCatch({
    getSymbols(symbol, src = source)
    df = get(symbol)
    if(silent == FALSE){
      print(paste0("Ação ", symbol, " baixada com sucesso."))
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    df = FALSE
    if(silent == FALSE){
      print(paste0("Erro ao baixar a ação ", symbol, "."))
    }
  })
  
  return(df)
}

turn_to_tsibble = function(stocks){
  n = nrow(stocks)
  date = seq(Sys.Date(), length.out = n, by = "day")
  df = data.frame(date = date, values = stocks[,4])
  colnames(df) = c("date", "values")
  df = df %>% as_tsibble(index = date)
  return(df)
}

get_series <- function(symbols, source = "yahoo", silent = TRUE){
  lista_stocks = list()
  
  for(n in 1:length(symbols)){
    lista_stocks[[n]] = get_df(symbols[n], source = source, silent = silent)
  }
  
  lista_stocks <- Filter(function(x) !is.function(x), lista_stocks)
  return(lista_stocks)
}
```

```{r}
df = turn_to_tsibble(lista_stocks[[1]])
```

```{r}
modelos <- df %>%
  model(Mean = MEAN(values),
        Naive = NAIVE(values),
        #SNaive = SNAIVE(values ~ lag(12)),
        Drift = RW(values ~ drift()),
        Decomposition = decomposition_model(STL(values ~ trend(window = 7), robust = TRUE), NAIVE(season_adjust)),
        TSM = TSLM(values ~ trend() + season()),
        #Fourier = TSLM(values ~ trend() + fourier(K = 4)),
        #Spline = TSLM(values ~ trend(knots = as.Date("2016-07-01"))),
        ETS = ETS(values ~ error("A") + trend("N") + season("N")),
        Holts = ETS(values ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("N")),
        Holts_Amortecido = ETS(values ~ error("A") + trend("Ad") + season("N")),
        Holts_Winter = ETS(values ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("A")))

modelos |> forecast(h = 30) |> autoplot(df, level = NULL) 
modelos %>% gg_tsresiduals()
```
